kind: evidence propositions, fixed BEFORE any corpus read (design only). Each proposition is a falsifiable historical claim; 'property' ties it to a frozen SPEC-G25-r1 property and the value that the claim REQUIRES. property=null means no frozen model can express it (CANNOT-EXPRESS).

propositions.claim: authorization carries an explicit scope and/or a named authority that limits what it permits
at every promotion event, the evidence floor holds (evidence present or eligible)
at every promotion event, the item meets the bar (eligible)
a promotion may proceed on an earlier authorization even though the floor no longer holds at promotion (strict TOCTOU permitted)
an adopted item can remain adopted after its evidence falls below the floor
every loss of adopted status is an explicit governance revocation act
adopted status is lost automatically when evidence falls below the floor
validation is a precondition of promotion (not merely an expectation)
after authorization and loss of the floor, promotion requires new evidence first
a change of the bar/rule changes the status of pending or adopted items
propositions.gap: A6 (u' = u) in every model; T5 only shows reachability

propositions.claim: pending (authorized, not promoted) items are governed by a stated transition rule when the bar changes
already adopted items are re-assessed when the bar changes
later evidence can overturn an adoption through a defined act
promotion is a discrete event distinct from the resulting adopted state
propositions.structural: every MT model separates the PromEvent step (ad 0->1) from the state ad; recorded as STRUCTURALLY-CONSISTENT, not a discriminator

propositions.claim: an exception below the bar requires that some evidence exists
an exception below the bar may be authorized with no evidence at all
no authorization below the bar is valid
